other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Offshore oil & gas production platforms with continuous power generation, flaring and venting operations (upstream E&P, not refining)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
During 2006 TEPUK industrial facilities generated 1.2 million tonnes CO2 from power generation, flaring and venting 
activities.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Energy indicator measuring energy consumed vs energy exported on a producing platform, treated as a plant over its life
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
For offshore sites the indicator which has been selected is that which measures energy consumed 
against energy exported.  This indicator represents the percentage of total energy produced that is consumed in the process of 
production.  As in all facilities this value changes over the life of the plant

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Planned energy efficiency surveys at a gas processing terminal (St Fergus), a continuous gas-processing facility
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
strengthened our aim to complete the two remaining energy efficiency 
surveys on the St Fergus terminal and Dunbar platform during 2008.

one_line: The paper describes energy efficiency assessments empirically carried out at Total E&P UK oil and gas installations (two offshore production platforms and an onshore office), an upstream oil & gas exploration/production context, not petroleum refining or any listed continuous-flow processing sector.
